label: HUAWEI WiFi Mesh 3+
description: HUAWEI WiFi Mesh 3+ mesh router: Wi-Fi 6 (2.4 GHz 574 Mbps + 5 GHz 2402 Mbps), 3x 1G adaptive Ethernet ports where any port can be the WAN.
notes: Vendor figures from Huawei's own spec page: **3 x 10/100/1000 Mbps adaptive rate Ethernet ports**, and the footnote matters - *"Adaptive WAN and LAN interfaces: the home network cable can be plugged into any network port"*. **There is no fixed WAN port**, so all three are modelled as plain 1G ports rather than one `wan` plus two `lan`. Wi-Fi 6, 2.4 GHz 574 Mbps + 5 GHz 2402 Mbps, 12 V/1 A, under 12 W, 250+ devices across a 3-pack, WPA3 and 802.11k/v/r roaming.
